title: Databases, buckets and a Kaggle search from DCLab Code's card, as on DCLab's page
request: The owner's goal: every agentic system of DCLab R&D works behind DCLab Code's chat with the same capabilities. After v1.42 a warehouse table or a bucket still meant leaving the chat for DCLab's page.
plan: read R&D's connector routes and its page's dialogs (draft/api.py data_database, data_cloud, kaggle_search; core.js connectors)
database and cloud answers with the page's bodies; the connectors' status and the Kaggle search relayed
the card's Connect panel with the four sources
tests, a check on a real rules-only R&D with a SQLite connection, review

decisions.decision: a database is chosen by the name of a connection DCLab's server defines; DCLab Code accepts only a name ([A-Za-z0-9_.-]) and never a URL
decisions.why: the connection string and its password stay on DCLab's server, as on its page; a URL typed into the card is refused before it travels

decisions.decision: the connectors' status and the Kaggle search are read without owning a draft
decisions.why: they read only (names, booleans, notes, public search results) and touch no draft or project

change: dclab-code c4305fd: server/dclab_person.js (database, cloud), server/app.js (connectors status, kaggle-search; recorded words), server/config.js and scripts/sync-check.js (the routes followed), web/draft.js (Connect panel), web/style.css, tests, docs/PARITY_PLAN.md.

findings.defect: two timing tests failed and a page test did not finish while the Mac ran at a load of about 45 from other work
findings.scenario: the full suite beside another project's agent and a dclabai job: keep-awake and terminal-close failed, a page test timed out
findings.cause: timing under load, not the change: each passed alone and the whole suite passed when the load fell
findings.fix: none in code; the suite rerun file by file once the load fell

measurements.name: tests
measurements.result: dclab-code 144 of 144 (page tests in Chromium), after a rerun under lower load

measurements.name: real R&D check
measurements.gate: a warehouse table imports through the card's channel; a write is refused
measurements.result: SQLite connection 'warehouse': table imported and cleaned (ready); DELETE refused 422 by R&D; Kaggle search 400 (no key on the server)

measurements.name: sync-check
measurements.gate: every R&D agent reached; every route used exists
measurements.result: 18 of 18 agents, in sync with R&D 7e5ad49b on GitHub

outcome: Every source of DCLab's Home page is in the card: upload, Kaggle (search and name), Hugging Face, a database, a bucket, and synthetic data.
lessons: When a suite fails only under heavy load from other work, rerun file by file before changing code, and say so.
risks: Kaggle needs the owner's key on DCLab's server
